hypotheses.name: Catalogue Strike-Field Gated Blind Potential-Field Edge Fusion (executes queued H86J-SCO at full-footprint scale)
layers: Native Band 5 iso_grav_anom_slope (pixel-verified = hypot(B11,B18)), Bands 11/18 signed gravity gradient vector, Band 13 iso_grav_anom
Native Band 3 tmi_hg, Band 2 rtp (gradient magnitude, sigma=1.5 px)
Native Band 15 depth_to_base_surf (gradient magnitude), Band 19 det_elev_slope
data/bridge/existing_faults.tif catalogue used ONLY to build a smoothed double-angle strike-orientation tensor field (visible-only inside holdout folds) and the >3.0 px emission collar
hypotheses.physical_signature: Basin-and-Range normal-fault populations are strongly oriented sets (NNE-SSW range-front grain, NW Walker Lane shear). A blind edge detector fires equally on fault steps and on strike-discordant non-fault edges (caldera ring margins, Lahontan shoreline benches, dike swarms, survey seams). Build a continuous strike field theta_C(x) by double-angle tensor smoothing (sigma 5 km) of the visible catalogue orientation; compute the local potential-field edge strike theta_E(x) from the verified gravity gradient vector (B18,-B11); gate a 5-plane multiline-corroborated edge fusion E (2nd-highest of grav/mag/rtp/basement/elev edge ranks, averaged with the rank mean) by spin-2 alignment A=cos^2(theta_E-theta_C): S = E*(0.35+0.65*A). Soft floor 0.35 keeps perpendicular accommodation/transfer faults reachable. Emit 37,654 dots, score-ordered Poisson-disk spacing 2.8 px, catalogue collar >3.0 px (H33 lineage emission fingerprint).
hypotheses.why_unmapped: Unmapped strands of an oriented fault population share the population strike even where buried under piedmont/basin cover with no scarp; 69.8% of the winning H33 dots sit >1 km from the catalogue, i.e. far-field parallel strands are exactly the live-scoring population, and an orientation prior (unlike tip/distance elastic kernels) does not decay with distance from the catalogue.
hypotheses.difference_from_repo: Every prior catalogue-context lane in this repo used distance-decaying near-field kernels (KSAD elastic lobes, tip cones, halo priors - all dead beyond ~1 km) or was purely blind. H86J-SCO proposed a local 5 km strike-tensor gate in prose but was never implemented; no shipped lane conditions a blind edge surface on a global interpolated catalogue strike FIELD. Verification 2026-10-26: no src/gems86_sco* and no scripts/run_*sco* exists; nearest relatives are data-only structure-tensor lanes (55GEMSDOE/59GEMSDOE tensor, H86K-STC coherence) which never read catalogue orientation.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Strike-parallel unfaulted lithologic contacts / depositional strike valleys along range fronts share the grain and will pass the gate; and genuine perpendicular transfer faults are down-weighted by the soft floor. Both are named failure modes measured by the E2 ungated ablation and per-fold holdout.
hypotheses.expected_dti_gain: Rank 1: +0.005 to +0.020 HOLDOUT-DTI over the ungated edge-fusion ablation (E2) on gems57-pooled-hide-v2; SGMC-PROXY-DTI at or above GEMSDOE32 H33's same-instrument 0.0937. Live projection is NOT claimed from this table; it is computed by the fleet regression estimator in the run card.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Low (~10 min CPU: 5 native-band edge planes + 2 tensor smoothings at 3730x3292 float32 + greedy emission; no ML training, no external downloads beyond the hash-pinned restore already verified).
hypotheses.official_data_obtainability: VIABLE_IN_SANDBOX_NOW - training_features.tif restored and SHA-256 verified this session (4371c82e...23bc5, owner mirror of the DrivenData file, NOT organizer-authenticated); catalogue/sample are the committed bridge files.

hypotheses.name: Detectability-Weighted PU Learning (negatives trusted only where mapping completeness is high)
layers: Native Bands 2,3,5,11,13,15,18,19 + Band 6 TC + GeoDAWN K/Th/U (ext_geodawn_rad_u8, restored+verified c22420f7...)
hypotheses.physical_signature: HistGradientBoosting PU classifier where negative sample weights scale with a visibility/completeness surface c(x) from basement depth (B15) and slope (B19): bedrock range fronts (c->1) supply trusted absences, deep covered basins (c->0) supply almost no negative evidence, directly attacking the documented PU failure mode (GEMSDOE91 S17-LFTG: 68.5% of dots crowded <1 km from catalogue because PU learned survey-exposure propensity).
hypotheses.why_unmapped: Covered-basin faults are unmapped because they are undetectable at the surface, not absent; standard PU treats their habitat as negative evidence and suppresses exactly those predictions.
hypotheses.difference_from_repo: KSAD computed a completeness surface as a fusion weight; no lane used completeness as the TRAINING sample-weight mechanism for negatives. Ranked below SFG: higher cost (LOQO HGB training in 3 GB RAM sandbox), and the fleet's PU/HGB lanes have the worst live track record (0.0286-0.19 OWNER-REPORTED).
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Playa/playette basins with genuinely no faults receive inflated scores once negative evidence is discounted.
hypotheses.expected_dti_gain: Rank 2: uncertain sign on catalogue-hide holdout (holdout truth is catalogue-like, favouring propensity learning); potentially + on SGMC far-field. Not run this session (budget: 3 experiments).
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Medium (~30-45 min CPU, sampling-based HGB under 4-fold LOQO).

hypotheses.name: Transient Fluvial Iso-Chi Knickzone Back-Projection (queued H86Q-3, carried forward unchanged)
hypotheses.physical_signature: Iso-chi knickzones aligned across >=3 adjacent footwall catchments back-projected down-channel to the B15 bedrock-alluvium step, reconstructing buried range-front strands (Perron & Royden 2013). Prior lanes used chi pixelwise at the knickpoint, 0.5-3 km upslope of the fault.
hypotheses.why_unmapped: Slow-slipping range-front scarps are erased by sheetflood aggradation in 20-50 kyr while footwall chi signals persist >0.5 Myr.
hypotheses.difference_from_repo: No lane performs catchment-graph down-channel projection. Not run this session: dem10_chi is NOT in research/upstream/data_manifest.json (verified 2026-10-26); it must first be pin-restored from the GEMSDOE24-family mirror (BFRA input pin 8897ba9c...) with a new manifest entry - obtainable in principle, not yet hash-pinned here.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Resistant welded-tuff/carbonate ledges produce lithologic knickpoints in unfaulted canyons.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Medium (~25 min CPU for D8 catchment graph) + restore work.
hypotheses.official_data_obtainability: NOT_YET_PINNED - free official source exists (USGS 3DEP) and a family mirror hash exists (8897ba9c...), but no manifest entry in this repo; do not propose as immediately viable until pinned.

hypotheses.name: Geothermal Manifestation Point-Alignment Corridors (RANSAC lines through GDR springs/wells/vents)
layers: DOE GDR submission 1391 gdr_wellspring_in_footprint.csv + gdr_volcanic_vents_in_footprint.csv (https://gdr.openei.org/submissions/1391; dist_known_fault_px strictly unread)
Native Band 17 cond_surf as corridor corroboration
hypotheses.physical_signature: Hydrothermal upflow localizes on permeable fault intersections; alignments of >=3 springs/warm wells/vents within a 300 m corridor over >=2 km trace blind permeable strands. Score = alignment density x conductivity rank.
hypotheses.why_unmapped: Blind geothermal systems by definition lack surface fault expression but leak fluids/heat along the buried structure (the INGENIOUS play concept).
hypotheses.difference_from_repo: Vents/springs entered prior lanes as pixel covariates (vent_corridor blur); no lane fit explicit point-alignment geometry as the primary surface. Ranked 4: point density inside the footprint is low, so recall at 37,654-dot budget is implausible as a standalone.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Well/spring siting follows roads, ranches and range-front water access, producing cultural alignments.
hypotheses.expected_dti_gain: Rank 4: high precision / very low recall; expected standalone HOLDOUT-DTI near zero at full budget.
hypotheses.official_data_obtainability: OBTAINABLE - CSVs are in research/upstream/data_manifest.json (ext_gdr_wellspring_in_footprint, ext_gdr_volcanic_vents_in_footprint) but were not restored this session.
